explanation: Naive Bayes multiplies the class prior by one likelihood per feature, which is the conditional-independence assumption. The spam numerator is 0.5·0.8·0.6 = 0.24 and the ham numerator is 0.5·0.4·0.3 = 0.06, so the posterior is 0.24/0.30 = 0.80. Using only one feature gives 2/3, and adding the feature probabilities instead of multiplying is a different model.
